title: Carthusianus
summary: Raleigh names Carthusianus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Carthusianus, named with S. Augustine, Theodoret, and Lyra among those who did not doubt of Nebuchadnezzar his saluation. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter I, §. XI, sig. 391b–392a
